I wonder that they cannot distinguish the cause from the condition, which the many,
feeling about in the dark, are always mistaking and misnaming.
And thus one man makes a vortex all round and steadies the earth by the heaven.
Another gives the air as a support to the earth, which is a sort of broad trough.
